subject: English
question_text: From your reading of the above passage fill in the blanks with
stimulus: suitable words. Use one word only in each blank : 1×5=5 Recently a sports club in Dhaka has launched a programme for giving (a) ⎯ training to the young and talented sportsmen and sportswomen. The programme will be (b) ⎯ the next year. For the (c) ⎯ three months they will be given free training but if anyone wants to get (d) ⎯ three months training she/he will be charged training fee for that. For the further trainings the (e) ⎯ will be another three months. It is a great opportunity for the interested candidates.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Barishal Board-2016 (Test Paper 127-150)
